1 #!/usr/bin/env node
2 // bin/plan-gate.mjs — wire researchPrime's ACTUAL Phase-1 research plan through the
3 // human two-gate approval (the "report the plan one-shot; user APPROVEs / EDITs / ABORTs
4 // before execution" behavior).
5 //
6 // Before this seam, the two-gate machine (bin/two-gate.mjs) only ever surfaced the generic
7 // `planMatrix` boilerplate at Gate 2 — never the rich Phase-1 plan the requester actually
8 // cares about. This module injects `buildResearchPlan` as the Gate-2 plan artifact so the
9 // human approves the real thing: AXIS + candidate branches + best-in-class baselines +
10 // the deterministic stakes vector / governor tier / Oranges foresight receipt.
11 //
12 // The plan artifact is a PURE function of the operator's frozen Phase-1 inputs (runPhase1 is
13 // deterministic; no clock, no randomness), so the same inputs serialize to the same bytes and
14 // the same planHash — which is what the Gate-2 EDIT re-hash discipline and replay fixtures rely on.
15 
16 import fs from 'node:fs';
17 import path from 'node:path';
18 import readline from 'node:readline/promises';
19 import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
20 
21 import { runTwoGateMachine } from './two-gate.mjs';
22 import { runPhase1 } from './phase1.mjs';
23 import { deriveGovernorContract } from './formal-governor.mjs';
24 import { HaltError } from './trio-core/contract-core.mjs';
25 
26 export const RESEARCH_PLAN_VERSION = 'researchPrime-phase1/1';
27 
28 /**
29  * Build the rich Phase-1 research plan artifact the human approves at Gate 2.
30  * PURE function of `inputs` (runPhase1 is deterministic) → stable planHash.
31  *
32  * @param {{inputs: object}} args
33  *   inputs: { objective|query, axis?, branches?, baselines?, stakes? }
34  * @returns {object} the plan artifact (serialized + hashed by the two-gate machine)
35  */
36 export function buildResearchPlan({ inputs } = {}) {
37   const src = inputs || {};
38   const objective = src.objective || src.query;
39   if (typeof objective !== 'string' || objective.length === 0) {
40     throw new TypeError('buildResearchPlan requires a non-empty objective');
41   }
42   const branches = Array.isArray(src.branches) ? src.branches : [];
43   const baselines = Array.isArray(src.baselines) ? src.baselines : [];
44   const receipt = runPhase1({ stakes: src.stakes ?? {}, plan: { branches } });
45   return {
46     planVersion: RESEARCH_PLAN_VERSION,
47     objective,
48     axis: src.axis ?? null, // the load-bearing win-condition + what FALSIFIES a candidate
49     branches, // candidate research branches
50     baselines, // best-in-class baselines to beat
51     tier: receipt.tier, // governor tier the Phase-3 loop scales by (projection of the stakes vector)
52     stakes: receipt.stakes, // carries the verbatim declared vector (`raw`) + axis_tiers
53     foresight: receipt.foresight, // Oranges receipt (dropped/reordered branch + counterfactual cost)
54   };
55 }
56 
57 /**
58  * Run the two-gate human approval with the REAL Phase-1 plan at Gate 2.
59  * Thin wrapper over runTwoGateMachine that injects `buildResearchPlan`.
60  *
61  * P0 2026-07-25 (journal 0004): the governance record now locks the REAL governor
62  * contract (thresholds/tier/roundBudget via deriveGovernorContract), not the two-gate
63  * `{hash:'mock-hash'}` placeholder — the placeholder short-circuited run-rounds'
64  * `lockedGovernorOutput ||` and crashed at `thresholds.N`, breaking the documented
65  * plan-gate → run-rounds happy path end-to-end. `provenance.inputsHash` mirrors to
66  * `.hash` to satisfy the governance-record validator. An explicitly-passed
67  * `opts.lockedGovernorOutput` still wins (tests / callers with their own lock).
68  *
69  * @param {object} inputs frozen Phase-1 inputs (see buildResearchPlan)
70  * @param {object} opts   forwarded to runTwoGateMachine (runDir, prompts, approvalProvider, …)
71  */
72 export async function runPlanReviewGate(inputs, opts = {}) {
73   let lockedGovernorOutput = opts.lockedGovernorOutput;
74   if (!lockedGovernorOutput) {
75     const contract = deriveGovernorContract(inputs);
76     lockedGovernorOutput = { ...contract, hash: contract.provenance.inputsHash };
77   }
78   return runTwoGateMachine(inputs, { ...opts, lockedGovernorOutput, buildPlan: buildResearchPlan });
79 }

81 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
82 // CLI: node bin/plan-gate.mjs <planInputs.json> [runDir]
83 // Presents the frozen Phase-1 plan to the operator at a TTY and records the
84 // hash-bound APPROVE/EDIT/ABORT decision as a durable governance record.
85 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
86 
87 function renderPlan(plan) {
88   const lines = [];
89   lines.push('──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');
90   lines.push('  researchPrime — PHASE-1 PLAN (review before execution)');
91   lines.push('──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');
92   lines.push(`  Objective : ${plan.objective}`);
93   lines.push(`  AXIS      : ${plan.axis ?? '(none stated)'}`);
94   lines.push(`  Stakes    : tier=${plan.tier}`);
95   lines.push('  Branches  :');
96   for (const b of plan.branches) lines.push(`    - ${typeof b === 'string' ? b : JSON.stringify(b)}`);
97   lines.push('  Baselines to beat:');
98   for (const b of plan.baselines) lines.push(`    - ${typeof b === 'string' ? b : JSON.stringify(b)}`);
99   const dropped = plan.foresight?.dropped ?? plan.foresight?.dropped_or_reordered;
100   lines.push(`  Foresight : ${plan.foresight?.stamp ?? JSON.stringify(dropped ?? plan.foresight ?? {})}`);
101   lines.push('──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────');
102   return lines.join('\n');
103 }
104 
105 async function askDecision(rl, label) {
106   const answer = (await rl.question(`${label} — APPROVE / EDIT / ABORT? `)).trim().toUpperCase();
107   return ['APPROVE', 'EDIT', 'ABORT'].includes(answer) ? answer : 'ABORT';
108 }
109 
110 function invokedDirectly() {
111   const entry = process.argv[1];
112   if (!entry) return false;
113   try { return path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) === path.resolve(entry); } catch { return false; }
114 }
115 
116 if (invokedDirectly()) {
117   const [planFile, runDirArg] = process.argv.slice(2);
118   if (!planFile) {
119     console.error('usage: node bin/plan-gate.mjs <planInputs.json> [runDir]');
120     process.exit(2);
121   }
122   const inputs = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(planFile, 'utf8'));
123   const runDir = runDirArg || path.join(path.dirname(path.resolve(planFile)), 'plan-gate-run');
124   fs.mkdirSync(runDir, { recursive: true });
125 
126   const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
127   runPlanReviewGate(inputs, {
128     runDir,
129     // Gate 1 = confirm scope/intake; Gate 2 = approve the rendered Phase-1 plan (the one-shot report).
130     promptGate1: async () => askDecision(rl, `\nScope: ${inputs.objective || inputs.query}`),
131     promptGate2: async ({ plan }) => {
132       console.log('\n' + renderPlan(plan));
133       return askDecision(rl, 'Plan');
134     },
135   })
136     .then((res) => {
137       rl.close();
138       console.log(`\n✔ Plan APPROVED. planHash=${res.planHash}`);
139       console.log(`  governance record → ${path.join(runDir, 'governance.json')}`);
140       process.exit(0);
141     })
142     .catch((err) => {
143       rl.close();
144       if (err instanceof HaltError || err.name === 'HaltError') {
145         console.error(`\n✖ HALTED: ${err.message}`);
146         process.exit(1);
147       }
148       console.error(err);
149       process.exit(2);
150     });
151 }
